notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #9
notes.content:
WARNING: High levels of genius detected!
Jimmy Neutron has entered the arena with his signature blend of science and chaos. The Nicktoons are officially reunited!


[previewyoutube="0fQXEGqpIK4;full"][/previewyoutube]


From high-tech lasers, turrets, and his trusty pup Goddard, Jimmy is prepared to blast his enemies with seven skills and abilities.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649889/e45dc374cfb3393bfe336690da98d4c0acdd1121.png"]

Jimmy Neutron - Abilities 

Laser Tag – Jimmy fires a pulse-blasting laser shot from Jimmy’s custom laser gun, scorching enemies and recharging mana in the process.

Laser Sword – Unleashes a mighty sword swing with a sweeping arc of energy with Jimmy’s high-voltage laser blade, knocking enemies back and inflicting “slow” and “shock” effects along with damage.

Good Dog! – Jimmy calls in his loyal robo-companion Goddard, who dashes forward and chomps enemies with mechanical precision, dealing attack damage.

Baseball Launcher Turret – Deploys an auto-pitching turret that hurls baseballs at high speed, pelting enemies with fast impact damage.

Test Tube Turret – Jimmy sets up a turret that lobs unstable chemical-filled test tubes, each one exploding in a blast of chemical reaction that deals explosive damage.

Ultra Punch Turret – Drops a spinning boxing-glove turret that unleashes a whirlwind of turbo-powered punches, knocking enemies back and racking up damage with every hit.

Overdrive Protocol – Jimmy activates a rapid-deploy sequence that instantly drops all three turret types, then supercharges them for maximum firepower while Overdrive Protocol is active.

notes.title: Q&A With The Developers - Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny
notes.content:
The community asked, we answered. 


You all have been sharing some fantastic questions about Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny, and we brought them straight to the devs!



We sat down with the developers, Petit Fabrik & Fair Play Labs, to talk through the community’s top asks from design inspirations to gameplay insights (and maybe some extra fun).


Q&A
Q: Why was the “tabletop” theme chosen for the game? -@duckscouttf2

A: We wanted to reference classic tabletop fantasy games and also the childhood feeling of casually playing board games in your bedroom on sleepover with childhood friends, everything should feel miniaturized and a bit wonky. On top of that, mashing this up with the power of the Fairly OddParents seemed like a super natural idea.



Q: What was your process for choosing the characters and their classes for this game? Was the focus more on figuring out which class would fit well for a specific character, or was it more figuring out which character would fit well for a specific class/gameplay style? -@grithalmur

A: We actually chose the characters first and after that we figured out where they would fit in RPG archetypes. We wanted to cover as much as we could in terms of giving players different playstyles and that’s not very hard to do with Nickelodeon characters, because they’re so versatile. Some of them of course ‘feel’ more natural in certain roles, but some of them also feel incredibly flexible to be honest. If for example the Knight class was already taken by any other character other than SpongeBob, I think we could have just as easily turned him into a bard, mage or even a summoner. Can you imagine that?



Q: If the bosses have classes like the playable characters, what would they be? (Example: Plankton as a Warlock) -@piplupknight

A: Most of them actually do have classes.  Just not all.

Plankton: Wizard

Angelica: Witch

Ember: Ember just screams Bard.

Azula: Pyromancer



Q: What games and/or stories influenced you for Dice of Destiny? -@jusjarbo4ever

A: Action RPGs in general, but more specifically we took a lot of inspiration from games like Diablo, Path of Exile, and more light titles like Minecraft Dungeons and Cat Quest. Also, games like Hades and Cult of the Lamb who helped us shape a lot of the aspects of our gameplay.



Q: Why did you decide on this specific art style (I love it btw) instead of going the traditional Nicktoons games? -@bearlysweaty

A: Thank you! We are so thrilled to get that type of feedback.  We wanted the feeling of a table top game, kinda like if they were paper characters standing on a thematic board game, tests were made on what would work or not, some had some more paper texture, other versions had some kind of normal map volume... The result we used in the game I think stands out and works well on highlighting the characters from the environment.



Q: Who out of the current characters revealed was the most fun to create and bring to life? -@oshacario

A: That’s a question that will have a completely different answer depending on who you ask. Since I feel everyone on the team has their own personal favorite character, I think it’s super safe to say that the sentiment was that it was a blast to bring all of them to life. Once you get into the process of turning the characters you’ve watched since forever on Nickelodeon’s shows into actual playable RPG characters it feels like you never want to stop. It’s a lot of fun coming up with abilities and later on seeing them come to life by the hands of so many talented artists, devs and of course, their voice actors!



Q: Will there be difficulty options included for more experienced RPG players and/or older Nicktoon fans to bite their teeth in? -@nico41969773

A: Of course! Every level can be played in higher difficulties, so finding the appropriate level of challenge for your style or ability won’t be a problem. 



Q: Are there going to be any iconic music tracks from various franchises within the game itself? -@jackcollins1416

A: All music in the game is original and also, the music team went super deep to bring elements and references to the compositions which make them really have that identity of the characters and shows they were inspired in. Answering this question actually kind of got me humming one of the first world’s theme songs. They’re quite catchy ;)



Q: Will the characters have interactions with one another throughout most of the game? -@iamapencil4

A: Yes! The game has a TON of dialogue, cinematics and cutscenes featuring amazing bits of interactions between all the characters in the game. WE hope Nick fans find it to be an incredible treat! We simply can’t wait to see what your reactions will be!



Q: Is the main story progression in this game entirely linear, or is there any degree of freedom/choice in terms of the order of which areas you can travel to/challenges you can take on? -@larkinson9140

A: The main story is completely linear. In terms of gameplay, however, the player can choose to complete side quests and to go back and play earlier levels in higher difficulties, adding a bit of fun and additional challenge.



Q:Will the game have a loot/gear system (different rarities, character-specific loot, etc)? -@dibby_cosplay

A: Yes. Throughout the adventure, the player will be able not only to collect, but also to buy an array of weapons and armors, each with different perks and adapted to each character. Gear can range from common, simple weapons and armor, to Epic hero-making equipment. Like in any good ARPG, itemization is key to success in the world of NatDoD.



Q: Can you tell us the thought process for choosing the 2012 Leonardo out of all the other turtles and iterations of TMNT? -@scooper4mvs

A: Great question!  We chose the 2012 Leo because the 2012 Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle series was the first to be a part of the Nicktoons family of shows.



Q: What are the development team’s favorite Nicktoons and how did you pick who was playable and who’s an NPC? -@soph1710

A: That’s truly an impossible question to answer because there’s not a unanimous reply! Each of us in the development team basically have their own. Some of us literally grew up watching TMNT, Rugrats and SpongeBob, while others (maybe the younger ones on the team, haha) grew up watching Avatar, Danny Phantom and My Life as a Teenage Robot. As for picking who would be a playable or NPC, believe me, if we could, we’d probably turn all NPCs into playables as well, but unfortunately we had to make some tough decisions. But even as NPCs, we made sure they deliver as much as they can of their characters through interactions and the quests you’re gonna get to play.



Q: What was it like coming up with character classes and their movesets? Were some more challenging than others? And how much did you consider their personalities when making them? -@arcad1ac

A: Once we had the roster locked down, we started filling in the roles with each of them. Some of them could fit more than one role easily, so that made it a little bit easier for us to come up with a balanced roster that doesn’t have any role repetition and can cover a wide breadth of gameplay possibilities. Their personalities and what they do in their shows were actually the basis for the design of their skills. For example: SpongeBob is a Spatula-wielding Knight and most of his skills, such as the Ol’Reliable and his Kah-Rah-Tay spinning move — both huge inspirations from the show, are gonna work super well in that role, which makes him fight a lot from up close, but at the same time to make his kit very robust, we also wanted to bring at least one long ranged option for SB, so when asking ourselves how to do it we though why not incorporate one of his hobbies into that? And that’s how we came up with his Bubble Blast attack, which is an incredible long-ranged choice for you to snipe enemies from afar in the field!



Q: How were the playable characters for this game chosen? -@alexmb1997

A: We wanted to include as many awesome Nick characters as possible, it was a huge mix of fan favorites, Nick suggestions and our favorites. Well, we’re fans too so I think it boils down to just fan favorites plus Nick suggestions then.



Q: Will there be any type of customization in any way shape or form for this game? -@tekoa

A: Yes. As of now, every character has a unique skin, and, who knows, maybe in the future new ones will be added.



Q: How did you come up with the idea to make this new Nicktoons game into a fantasy RPG? -@saiyanspongecinema

A: We imagined bringing them to this medieval fantasy environment would be super fun and give us freedom to mash many parts of each IP together, at the same time, it would print that feeling of a "special middle ages episode" into our game, everything has its own fantasy version, it works really well.



Q: Almost immediately after the announcement, we’ve seen a dragon depicted on the cover art; anything you can tell us about it? -@jsb7778

A: Every fantasy RPG needs a dragon to call yours. Ours is one of a kind… Can’t say more without spoiling the fun, but rest assured that this one won’t make things easy for the adventurers. And we can’t wait for you to see… 


[hr][/hr]


If there’s something you’re still curious about, drop it in the comments, Steam discussion tab, or ask it in our Discord server! As much as we want to answer all of the amazing questions we receive, we have to keep some surprises for the launch later this month ;)

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #8
notes.content:
Half-teenager, half-robot, ALL power.
From sawblades to homing missiles, Jenny Wakeman is bringing the heat (and the hardware) to the fight!


[previewyoutube="kt1j2GRrJD4;full"][/previewyoutube]


Armed with drills, missiles, and unstoppable firepower, Jenny is ready to defend her friends and take on any foe with seven skills and abilities. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649889/e3115471e76ff04debc4a183efe76450219c4fa5.png"]

Jenny Wakeman - Abilities 

Dual Crossbows – Jenny’s twin crossbows fire in perfect sync, unleashing a relentless volley of bolts that tear through foes while recovering mana.

Homing Missile – Jenny launches a large precision-guided missile, it locks onto an enemy, chasing them down before erupting in a massive explosion.

Big Fist – With overwhelming force, Jenny swings her enlarged mechanical fists forward, dealing crushing damage to everything unlucky enough to stand in her way.

War Hammer – Jenny hefts a massive war hammer, charging it with raw mechanical strength before slamming it down in a bone-rattling strike.

Drill Dash – A directional dash attack. Jenny transforms her arm into a drill and rockets forward, boring through enemies with unstoppable momentum and dealing attack damage to all enemies contacted.

Saw Blades – Whirring saws spin as Jenny spins in a 360 attack. Twirling like a cyclone through the fight, she shreds enemies apart while recharging her mana.

All Out Attack – Jenny’s Ultimate Attack. She unleashes her ultimate weaponry, firing a storm of missiles and a powerful energy blast in one direction, engulfing the battlefield in devastating power.

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #7
notes.content:
Ready to go ghost?
Danny Phantom phases into battle as a shadowy powerhouse, ready to haunt the forces of evil.


[previewyoutube="yZqoWBiBf9s;full"][/previewyoutube]


Bringing his ghostly powers and rogue moves to the party, Danny Phantom offers seven skills and abilities to choose from.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649889/0dcc19e84f595e9aad73f82a6fa861385fe8735e.png"]

Danny Phantom - Abilities

Ectoplasm Stab Combo – A rapid and precise three-hit combo with Danny’s spectral energy blades. Hits hard and recharges mana.

Invisibility – Go ghost for a short amount of time and strike from the shadows. Enemies cannot see Danny or attack him. While cloaked, every hit is a guaranteed critical hit.

Ectoplasm Punch – Danny dashes forward with his fist in a ghostly burst, striking all enemies in his path with ectoplasmic force.

Energy Blast – Charge it up and let it rip! A powerful, directional energy blast that deals more damage with charge time.

Flashing Energy Dagger – Danny spins his ghost-forged daggers in the air before catching them with a searing flash that blinds nearby foes in place for a short time.

Ghostly Wail – His signature scream! Danny unleashes a devastating blast that hits every enemy in a 360 range with a mighty scream.

Ghostly Duplication – Danny generates a phantom clone of himself! The clone mimics his every move in battle. The skill button locks the duplicate in one spot, before recalling it with another press of the skill button.



Are you ready to go ghost? Who do you want to see next?

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #6
notes.content:
She’s got charm, sparkle, and a spell for every situation.
Susie Carmichael just enchanted the whole party!


[previewyoutube="VH36S5zsHlU;full"][/previewyoutube]


With grace in her steps, magic in her words, and seven skills and abilities to choose from - Susie is not a character you want to underestimate. 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649889/ec660e05b5901b1dc5846b3463e7870ca9ecc649.png"]

Susie Carmichael - Abilities

Fireball – Susie opens her enchanted spellbook, summoning Reptar’s head from its pages. With a mighty growl, Reptar breathes a fireball that blasts enemies. Fireballs deal damage on impact and restore a burst of mana.

Toy Bricks – Susie tosses a small, enchanted pouch that bursts on impact, scattering magical toy bricks across the ground. Enemies who walk over them are slowed and take damage.

Jack-in-the-Box – She tosses a mischievous Jack-in-the-Box that springs open and strikes nearby enemies for damage.

Unicorns of the Sea – Susie surrounds herself with a floating array of narwhals and launches them forward one by one by pressing the Skill button. Each narwhal strike deals damage to enemies.

Healing Spell – Susie conjures a radiant zone of magic that heals herself and nearby allies continuously for 10 seconds.

Spike Stampede – Susie summons a stampeding herd of Spike, the loyal family dog. The herd charges forward with puppy power and enemies in the path are knocked back and take damage.

Reptar’s Roar! – With a flash of magic, Susie summons the mighty Reptar from her spellbook! He charges into battle for a short time, unleashing powerful strikes that deal damage with every hit.



Now that Susie is here and ready to play, who do you think is next?

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #5
notes.content:
Brains, brawn, and a whole lotta Texan tenacity.
Sandy Cheeks is here and ready to battle her way through any challenges!


[previewyoutube="0fP5F1NYvVc;full"][/previewyoutube]


Sandy Cheeks ain’t just smart — she hits like a truck in a tree dome. Fueled by rage and armed with seven different abilities, she’s sure to strike all her enemies down with ease.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649889/61effd9fa50356d4cd0d40d04cb64fabfb53fdfb.png"]

Sandy Cheeks - Abilities

Hammer Swing – A classic and simple double-hit hammer combo that deals damage and restores mana with each swing.

Avalanche Strike – Sandy launches into the air and slams down with a devastating shockwave, damaging all enemies around her. While airborne, press the Skill button again to perform a mid-air stomp and end the attack early.

Rodeo Lasso – Sandy throws her lasso to snare enemies, yanking anyone caught straight toward her. She can then follow up with any available attacks.

Texas! – Fueled by rage, Sandy powers up and enters Rage Mode, greatly increasing her attack strength for a short time

Big Acorn – Sandy eats a large acorn. It restores health over time, gradually healing Sandy for several seconds.

Hurricane Attack – Sandy spins continuously with a powerful 360-degree kick, striking all nearby enemies with rapid, circular force.

Hibernation Mode – Sandy taps into her primal instincts and turns into hibernation Sandy, boosting her strength. While active, her ground-slamming attacks deal heavy damage in a wide radius.


Now that your new favorite Barbarian, Sandy Cheeks, has joined the adventure - who do you think is next?

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #4
notes.content:
One kid, two fairies, and a lot of chaos. 
Timmy Turner casts himself into the quest with Cosmo and Wanda at his side!


[previewyoutube="bqhGtMBEw0c;full"][/previewyoutube]


With magical mayhem at his fingertips, Timmy Turner enters the realm! But, be careful what you wish for… it just might zap your enemies. 


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXckaX7a4kYmL9bOEW9sbhP9mFNoIzgX46X9FkAqd6q8zIM-U1V2BgqMg14uaDHO_J_hWhctPSf91SXQ-Z-9igKajDORQvukn9bsWK3sNTq4BviwkYuFV-HRDfBIp2j43koEKtVLBg?key=T1mdsvNqpdBcjXjUU4p60Q"]

Timmy Turner - Abilities 

Scepter Beam – Unleashes a crackling elemental ray that cycles between Fire, Lightning, and Ice. Each second brings a new element and a fresh debuff. Zapping enemies restores mana. The attack can chain damage to nearby enemies.

Vacuum Ball – A vacuum that slowly siphons energy from enemies as it pulls them inward, dealing damage with each tick. Enemies below 20% HP are instantly absorbed into the swirling core, forming the Vacuum Ball. Once charged, it can be hurled at enemies dealing attack damage.

Elemental Wall – Summons a random elemental wall of Fire, Lightning, or Ice that deals damage and knocks enemies backward with a satisfying poof.

Mushroom Rain – Opens a magical portal that drops enchanted mushrooms from the sky. Each one smacks enemies for damage and randomly applies poison, burn, or freeze them.

Spiky Ball – Summons a giant, glittery spiked ball that bounces three times before exploding. Or press skill button again to blow it up early. Deals damage to any enemy in it’s path.

Piñata’s Revenge – A totally cursed piñata taunts nearby enemies into attacking it. While it’s up, your hits grant random buffs and enemy hits cause random debuffs. After a few seconds… KABOOM. Candy and damage for everyone in range.

A Really Dangerous Weapon – Drops a magical cannon that fires a barrage of magical cannonballs. Hits enemies with rapid-fire blasts of damage. Nobody's quite sure where Timmy got it. Definitely not approved by Da Rules.



Now that Timmy Turner is officially in the party (with backup of course), who do you think is next?

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #3
notes.content:
A calm mind. A fierce spirit. A wave of power. 
Katara has joined the quest bending more than just water—she bends the odds.

[previewyoutube="AUYjmlGRYF4;full"][/previewyoutube]

Calm, focused, and absolutely freezing the competition, Katara’s playable character offers seven water-themed skills and abilities for you to choose from. 


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcGlqgLb-Lj35q7LlL0WAhtqTUlMb2ZueUOdQVzzT8ii3MqC4-VSM_JTsr4qsfZREus7LRkHNn3Ix_TDLvaznRysnGg2Gc8St0fH4NEAQvOwNDrLtLLWHJYtmqODCT0nks2C6DexA?key=T1mdsvNqpdBcjXjUU4p60Q"]

Katara - Abilities

Water Whip – With a snap of her wrist, Katara lashes out a serpent-like whip of water. Striking true restores her mana and leaves behind a slick puddle that speeds up allies and bogs down enemies.

Water Wave – Katara commands a towering wave to surge forward, crashing into enemies with the full force of the ocean and both pushes enemies back, and deals damage.

Ice Pillar – She raises a towering pillar of ice that, when struck, launches spinning frost discs that deal damage to enemies in every direction.

Healing Pool – Katara summons a soothing spring beneath her feet, bathing allies in restorative waters that steadily mend their wounds.

Frozen Rain Barrage – She conjures a burst of glacial energy that rains frozen shards ahead, striking enemies with an unforgiving storm of ice.

Frozen Prison – Katara traps the battlefield in frost, freezing puddles and foes alike in a chilling snare that deals damage and halts their advance.

Focus – Katara centers her spirit in a deep waterbending stance, restoring mana and forming a protective current that reduces incoming damage.


Welcome, Katara, to the growing lineup! We'd love to hear your favorite Nicktoons characters and who you're hoping to see in the Dice of Destiny.

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #2
notes.content:
Did someone order a pizza? 
Leonardo is here. And he’s bringing both blades!


[previewyoutube="sUGM96c4ebg;full"][/previewyoutube]

Slice and dice through the chaos with crossed katanas and strike your enemies down with the turtle tornado. Leonardo’s playable character offers seven skills and abilities for you to choose from.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45649889/56e12ce598c715665f8152893c17041bd8ca1efc.png"]

Leonardo - Abilities

Counter Stance – Leo assumes a defensive stance with crossed katanas. If struck by an enemy, he instantly responds with a 360-degree counterattack, delivering critical damage in all directions.

Crescent Blade – With a single swing, Leo hurls a crescent-shaped wave of sword energy that cuts through foes at range.

Dual Strike – Leo charges a swing of his katanas and unleashes them as he launches forward in a dual sword attack, dealing attack damage to enemies in his path. This is a directional attack.

Flying Kick – Leo leaps in the air and delivers a swift, forward flying kick, striking all enemies in his path and dealing attack damage and knocking them back with solid impact.

Katana Slash – Leo delivers a powerful triple-strike sword combo with his katana, slicing through nearby enemies and dealing attack damage. Each strike helps restore a bit of mana.

Turtle Tornado – Shell, steel, and spinning speed. Leo spins with blades outstretched, striking all enemies around him and dealing solid attack damage.

Zen State of Mind – Leo channels inner calm into pure offense, boosting his attacks for 12 seconds and unleashing energy slashes with every strike.

notes.title: Nicktoons & The Dice of Destiny - Character Reveal #1
notes.content:
Cue the drumroll for our first character reveal: 
Fan-favorite goofy goober, SpongeBob SquarePants, has entered the adventure as a Knight!


[previewyoutube="a5h7kpABHtk;full"][/previewyoutube]

Armed with spatulas and ready to bubble blast his way through any question, SpongeBob’s playable character offers seven skills and abilities for you to choose from.


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfP8p2Y-eTEcrNW1LuoSOEsdsmn8DHzcq8kmTY1a_-vKYBaKojWrGVMyyg336Ck0NovMvZWJIUUVtAIFPt2hy8t00NKgFpvrnRkgYuYKrwqrrs3kV9-dpZ15bhZdUlksOn4HXX3pg?key=T1mdsvNqpdBcjXjUU4p60Q"]

SpongeBob SquarePants - Abilities

Bubble Blast – A ranged attack where SpongeBob blows a giant bubble to inflict attack damage to enemies in its bubbly path.

Goofy Goober! – SpongeBob sports his wizard costume and elevates above the battlefield while blasting 360 degrees with his guitar to inflict ranged damage.

Kah-Rah-Tay! – SpongeBob performs a spinning 360 attack while wearing his Kah-Rah-Tay gloves to deal martial-arts style attack damage.

Ol' Reliable – SpongeBob bashes enemies with his trusty jellyfish net, “Ol’ Reliable”, in a forward attack to inflict damage on his adversaries.

Pretty Patty – SpongeBob eats a Pretty Patty for healing power to restore his health.

Shield Bash – A shield attack that can be charged. The shield blocks damage while SpongeBob charges the bash attack. It then deals attack damage on release, pushing enemies back.

Order Up! Combo – SpongeBob swings his spatula like a sword. String attacks together into a triple-attack spatula combo that deals attack damage. Also recovers his mana.
